newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on professional sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on professional sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended slightly lower on Monday compared to New York's previous close on professional sales, but prices bounced back from intra-day lows on physical demand, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$337.20/70 per ounce on Monday compared to New York's previous close at US$337.40/90 on Friday.
"After all that selling, the market picked up quite a bit, much of it on physical demand," said one source.
Dealers reported professional selling in afternoon trade.
Physical buying picked up at $337 per ounce and below, pulling gold back up from its intra-day low of $336.80/337.30 per ounce, dealers said.
Nonetheless, sentiment was bearish and traders saw gold pushing lower towards $335 per ounce.
Local tael gold ended HK$3 down at HK$3,123.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous fix at -8.00.
